testcase.name: nothing known at all leaves the tile as its logo
not playing flips the last track behind the logo, with no controls and no growth
a stall mid-song does not shrink the tile
starting, pausing and stopping each republish
playing puts the player on the front of the tile, with controls, and grows it
playing and buffering both count as playing
an idle tile carries no tap targets, so a tap on it launches the app as it always did
a position tick does not even change the art
the same song three seconds later publishes nothing
with nothing playing the most recent session is followed
no sessions at all is not an error
a playing session wins over a paused one, whatever order they arrive in
the art is re-read only when the track changes
the tile is never both the player and a flipping tile
paused, stopped and none do not
